entities.name: Víctor González Torres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor González Torres is a Mexican pharmaceutical businessman and politician, popularly known as Doctor Simi, the name of the character that represents his chain of companies, collectively called Farmacias Similares. In 2022 it became a trend to throw Doctor Simi plushies to singers in Mexico, and this was widely covered in social media.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor González Torres is a Mexican pharmaceutical businessman and politician, popularly known as Doctor Simi, the name of the character that represents his chain of companies, collectively called Farmacias Similares. In 2022 it became a trend to throw Doctor Simi plushies to singers in Mexico, and this was widely covered in social media.
